title: CTE for Department Salary Stats
description: Use a CTE to compute department salary statistics and filter high-paying departments.

data.text: Using a CTE, find departments whose average salary exceeds $70,000.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
WITH DeptSalary AS (
    SELECT
        DepartmentID,
        COUNT(*) AS EmpCount,
        AVG(Salary) AS AvgSalary
    FROM Employees
    GROUP BY DepartmentID
)
SELECT
    d.DepartmentName,
    ds.EmpCount,
    ds.AvgSalary
FROM DeptSalary ds
JOIN Departments d ON ds.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
WHERE ds.AvgSalary > 70000
ORDER BY ds.AvgSalary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: A CTE (Common Table Expression) defined with WITH gives a name to a subquery, making it reusable in the main query. CTEs improve readability over nested subqueries and can be referenced multiple times in the outer query.
